_about: Boeing (Douglas), DC-9 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Rev F 5/84), 2.2 General Airplane Dimensions, Model DC-9-32 (page index 14): its plan, layers.py --mode image at scale 4 --unrotate --rotate 179.57, clip 92,392,530,730. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side: door A, the service door; 2.4 names door B the main entry door). Drawn at the side view's scale. The nose tip sits on a grid line (x 35-39); ahead of the wing the fuselage's side runs a few px from another (y 609.5). The wing's leading edge is the foremost of its two parallel lines (the other is the slats' line); its trailing edge is the rearmost, one straight line from the root (947, 601) to the tip (the lines between are the flaps' and spoilers'; the vertical at 973 is the grid). The tailplane covers the tail cone: the fuselage's side is bridged (hidden) from the tailplane's root to the tail cone's end, a free point at the side view's tail. The nacelle's sides (engine.outer, engine.inner) place it: its middle 2.69 m out against the printed 2.70 m (the front view's inlet ring draws it 2.74 m out). The stub pylon: its leading edge the short line at 1113 from the fuselage to the nacelle, its trailing edge the swept line from the nacelle (1362, 588) to the fuselage (1393, 631).
